mapper.sql: st.*, s.code AS supplier_code, s.name AS supplier_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name
FROM fin_supplier_statement st LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = st.supplier_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = st.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fin_supplier_statement_line WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} ORDER BY bill_date, id

SELECT b.id AS bill_id, b.bill_no, b.source_type, b.source_no, b.bill_date, b.amount, b.tax_amount FROM fin_bill b WHERE b.kind = 'AP' AND b.partner_id = #{supplierId} AND b.bill_date >= #{begin} AND b.bill_date <= #{end} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_supplier_statement_line l WHERE l.bill_id = b.id) ORDER BY b.bill_date, b.id
mapper.insert:

(#{l.statementId}, #{l.billId}, #{l.billNo}, #{l.sourceType}, #{l.sourceNo}, #{l.billDate}, #{l.amount}, #{l.taxAmount}, NOW())
